{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to numeric, handling non-numeric entries
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Identify the 6 invalid revenue entries
invalid_revenue_indices = sales_df[sales_df['revenue'].isnull()].index
print("Indices of invalid revenue entries:", invalid_revenue_indices.tolist())

# Examine the rows with invalid revenue
invalid_rows = sales_df.loc[invalid_revenue_indices]
print("Invalid rows:")
print(invalid_rows[['order_id', 'status', 'revenue', 'converted']])"}
